about.title: About TechnoFilter
about.missionText: TechnoFilter is an AI-powered system designed to detect manipulative and corruption-driven technical specifications in government procurement tenders in Kazakhstan.
about.problemText: Government procurement in Kazakhstan amounts to approximately 5 trillion tenge annually. A significant portion of tenders contain specifications deliberately crafted to favor a single pre-selected vendor, eliminating fair competition.
about.solutionText: Using advanced AI algorithms, natural language processing, and pattern recognition, TechnoFilter automatically analyzes tender documents and flags suspicious specifications that may indicate corruption.
about.step1: Data Collection — Tenders are collected from goszakup.gov.kz
about.step2: AI Analysis — Our ML engine extracts risk signals from tender text
about.step3: Risk Scoring — Each tender receives a composite risk score (0-100)
about.step4: Flag Generation — Specific red flags are identified with evidence
about.step5: Review — Analysts review high-risk cases for further action
about.impactText: By automating the detection of suspicious procurement patterns, TechnoFilter can help save billions of tenge in public funds and promote fair competition in government procurement.
